name: SRA-8901A 12G-SDI reclocking DA (1x10 or 1x5)
source: Ross SRA-8901A product page and rear module drawings
notes: Current version of the SRA-8901: 12G/6G/3G/HD/SD, DVB-ASI and MADI reclocking DA with long-reach equalisation, all outputs non-inverting. Ordered as SRA-8901A-R3 (1x10) or SRA-8901A-R3S (1x5, the split module takes a second card). The R3 module has a position B under the input that the single-channel card leaves unused. Under 5.6 W. OG3-FR and OGX-FR only.

rearModules.name: Split rear module (2 cards, 1 in, 5 out each)

name: DRA-8902A dual-input 12G-SDI DA (2 in, 10 out)
source: Ross DRA-8902A product page and rear module drawing
notes: Current dual-input 12G/6G/3G/HD/SD/ASI/MADI DA: inputs A and B feed an internal crosspoint to 10 outputs; each output pair follows either input or fails over automatically. Ordered as DRA-8902A-R3. Under 5.6 W. OG3-FR and OGX-FR only.

name: SRA-8901-R 12G bypass protection switch with DA
source: Ross SRA-8901-R product page and rear module cabling drawing
notes: Relay bypass protection: on loss of the primary input the protected output switches to the bypass input (manual or automatic return). Outputs 2-4 are reclocked copies of the primary. Single slot, up to 20 per OG3-FR/OGX-FR, 5 W max. Ordered as SRA-8901-R-R3S; one R3S-8901-R module serves two cards. Pairs with MC1 for master control protection.

name: MC1-UHD master control (Gator openGear card)
source: Ross MC1 product page and rear module drawings
notes: Master control switcher on a Gator card: 6 SD/HD/3G/12G-SDI in and 6 out on HD-BNC, frame reference or its own Ref In, TTL GPI/tally on terminal blocks, TSL 3.1 and automation over IP or serial. Licences: MC1-12G-LICENSE (UHD), MC1-MASTERCTRL-LICENSE, MC1-DVE-1CH-LICENSE; optional MC1-PANEL-16 hardware panel. Often paired with an SRA-8901-R bypass card. Gator cards take two front slots. R4 modules fit oGx frames (OGX-FR-CN/CNS) only; R3A/R3B modules are 4 slots wide (5 cards per frame). Check: GPIO count on the R3A/R3B modules and whether the RS-422 port is RJ45.

name: GATOR-TOOLBOX UHD up/down/cross, HDR and frame sync
source: Ross GATOR-TOOLBOX product page and rear module drawings
notes: UHD/HD up/down/cross conversion, HDR conversion, frame sync and optional frame-rate standards conversion over 12G-SDI. SDI is set as 4 in / 1 out (quad-link to single) or 1 in / 4 out; the R4 module has 12 HD-BNC positions, 4 of them unused (N/C). Gator cards take two front slots. R4 modules fit oGx frames (OGX-FR-CN/CNS) only; R3A/R3B modules are 4 slots wide (5 cards per frame).

name: GATOR-SYNC quad 12G frame synchroniser
source: Ross GATOR-SYNC product page
notes: Four independent frame synchronisers (HD/3G/12G, each at its own format) with multi-frame delay (79 frames HD, 14 UHD) and 16 embedded audio channels per stream with +/-500 ms offset. Discrete audio rear modules are planned. Gator cards take two front slots. R4 modules fit oGx frames (OGX-FR-CN/CNS) only; R3A/R3B modules are 4 slots wide (5 cards per frame). Check: SDI positions (assumed 4 in, 4 out like the Toolbox R4 drawing).

name: TES-8943 VANC data processor (SCTE-104)
source: Ross TES-8943 product page
notes: Inserts, processes and extracts VANC data; SCTE-104 insertion and detection; data in or out over TCP/IP or serial. SD/HD/3G standard, 6G/12G with TES-8943-12G-LICENSE. R4 needs OGX-FR-CN/CNS; R3B also fits OG3-FR-CN/CNS. Gator cards take two front slots. R4 modules fit oGx frames (OGX-FR-CN/CNS) only; R3A/R3B modules are 4 slots wide (5 cards per frame). Check: SDI positions on the Gator modules for this card (assumed 4 in, 4 out).

name: OSG-8971 SRT encoder/decoder (6 SDI I/O)
source: Ross OSG-8971 product page
notes: Hardware SRT encoder and decoder (H.264 and H.265): each of the six HD-BNC ports is set as input or output, so one card encodes and decodes at once; up to 6 HD/3G or 2 UHD streams (OSG-8971-UHD-LICENSE), key+fill pairs, 8 audio channels per stream (16 with OSG-8971-A16-LICENSE). Up to 10 per oGx frame with an advanced network controller.

name: SFC-6901 12G-SDI fibre transport (4 SDI, 4 SFP)
source: Ross SFC-6901 product page
notes: SD to 12G-SDI and ASI electrical/optical conversion with CWDM support and an on-board gearbox for quad-link UHD/8K. The 4 HD-BNCs are each set as input or output; the 4 SFP+ cages take dual Tx, dual Rx or transceiver SFPs (SFP-FIBER-12G-2T / -2R / -2R-H, SFP-FIBER-12G, CWDM -2T-xx/yy), ordered separately. 5 W. OG3 and OGX frames.

name: WDA-8409 word clock DA
source: Ross WDA-8409 product page and rear module drawings
notes: Word clock DA up to 192 kHz: Hi-Z or 75 ohm input, 75 ohm outputs. Ordered as WDA-8409-R2L or WDA-8409-R2S. Under 2 W. DFR-8321, OG3-FR and OGX-FR.

source: Ross HDC-8223A-S product page and rear module drawings
notes: 2 in (A/B) / 4 out reclocking DA whose SDI/CVBS outputs can each be SDI or analog composite with 10-bit HD down conversion; the -S version adds a frame synchroniser and audio sample-rate conversion. The same rear modules fit the HDC-8223A (no frame sync). 8 W.

name: MUX-8258-4C 4 ch analog audio embedder
source: Ross MUX-8258-4C/8C product page and rear module drawing
notes: Embeds 4 balanced analog audio channels into 3G/HD/SD-SDI with per-input gain, invert, delay and summing. 9.5 W. The shared R2C module has 8 analog positions; the -4C uses the first 4.

name: DMX-8259-4C 4 ch analog audio de-embedder
source: Ross DMX-8259-4C/8C product page and rear module drawing
notes: De-embeds 4 channels from 3G/HD/SD-SDI to balanced analog outputs; any embedded channel to any output, with gain, delay and invert. 9.5 W.

name: MUX-8258-8C 8 ch analog audio embedder
source: Ross MUX-8258-4C/8C product page and rear module drawing

name: DMX-8259-8C 8 ch analog audio de-embedder

notes: De-embeds 8 channels from 3G/HD/SD-SDI to balanced analog outputs; any embedded channel to any output, with gain, delay and invert. 11 W.

name: ADC-8434-A quad analog to dual AES converter
source: Ross ADC-8434-A product page and rear module drawing
notes: 4 balanced analog channels to 2 unbalanced AES3 streams (24-bit, 32-96 kHz); each AES stream comes out on two BNCs (AES Out 1, 1, 2, 2). 4 W.

name: AAP-8644 advanced audio processor (Dolby, loudness)
source: Ross AAP-8644 product page
notes: 3G/HD/SD audio processor: Dolby encode/decode, real-time loudness levelling, upmix, embed/de-embed, optional A/V QC with hardware relay bypass. 24 W with DSP options. Double-width card on a 4-slot rear module. Check: exact BNC split on the R2C-8644 module (counts from the spec table: up to 4 SDI in, 4 x 2 SDI out, 8 AES in, 8 AES out).
